purpose: Define auditable tactical state types and source-time transport contracts for weather/wind and line observations without inventing transition probabilities or promoting expected lines to observed lines.

supported_concepts: self-powered front rider followed by chasing riders
rider introduction/leg-show occurs before the race
riders use it to show intended line formation/ordering
wind direction, wind speed and track circumference are decision-relevant

notes: JMA publishes time-indexed historical meteorological observations including wind direction/speed where station elements are available.
JMA notes published historical data can be corrected later.
JMA explicitly requests avoiding excessive automated access; no bulk crawler is authorized here.

tactical_state_contract.rule: The state vocabulary is reality-supported at the concept level, but transition probabilities, utility effects and event frequencies remain UNKNOWN/ASSUMPTION_RANGE. No candidate may define them.
minimum_transition_invariants: PRE_START_LINE_INTENT cannot transition directly to TERMINAL_FINISH
SWITCHING requires a prior in-race state
No transition has an implicit numeric probability in v0

line_observation_contract.hard_prohibition: POST_RACE_RECONSTRUCTED_LINE may never be admitted as PRE.

expected_line.meaning: A pre-race provider/public prediction or declared expected formation available before cutoff.

legshow_observed_line.meaning: Formation/order actually observed during official pre-race rider introduction/leg-show.

hard_rules: source station/location mapping must be explicit
missing wind direction/speed stays missing; no silent engineering Gaussian substitution
historical JMA corrections do not erase the need to preserve capture/provenance semantics
indoor/no-wind venue facts may override outdoor weather only when venue geometry is officially bound

anti_affinity_boundary: No tactical transition coefficient may be chosen from PEER/N1/C1/C0 performance.
No line observation class may be relabeled after outcomes are known.
No weather value may be post-hoc selected because it improves model performance.
No truth-world execution under this foundation gate.
